content: Case preservation: standard technique is lowercase layout map + per-character case restoration (if source char was uppercase, uppercase the mapped char). Handles GHBDTN->ПРИВЕТ, Ghbdtn->Привет, ghbdtn->привет and mixed shapes like gHBdtn->пРивеТ. Punto additionally offers Alt+Break to cycle case (upper/lower/title) of selected or recent text. No competitor documents anything beyond per-character mapping; punctuation and digits pass through unchanged; Russian letters without Latin pair on the same key position are the special table cases.
